name: Polmanar
description: Polmanar was a planet located in the Anoat sector of the galaxy. At the time of the Galactic Empire's Iron Blockade of the sector, Polmanar was a base of the Trade Spine League. When Leeka Pali of the Trade Spine League suspected double-dealings from one of their own, she covertly sent a young smuggler to the planet to see if her suspicions had any merit.
